description: Defines the ReactAgentScreen widget, a main screen for the ReAct Agent Flutter app, including UI layout, user interactions, and state management.

classes.name: ReactAgentScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the primary interface of the ReAct Agent app, managing UI layout and user interactions.

classes.name: _PrimaryActionButton
classes.description: A custom button widget with gradient styling, indicating agent status and initiating actions.
